Tool: Mixo Supports Services: Service 2 / djying Category: Library Management Primary Use: Seamlessly transfers music libraries between Serato, Rekordbox, and Virtual DJ. Why It Matters (2026): Essential for DJs transitioning between different hardware ecosystems and software platforms. Notes: Provides a painless method for keeping playlists synced across laptop and mobile devices.
Tool: Moises Supports Services: Service 2 / djying Category: Remix Preparation Primary Use: Isolates vocals, drums, and bass from existing tracks for live remixing. Why It Matters (2026): Allows DJs to extract acappellas or drum loops from any song for creative on-the-fly mashups. Notes: Often used with magnetic phone mounts for easy visibility in the DJ booth.
